title: Sine Wave
description: Interactive demonstration of sine wave parameters including amplitude, period, and phase with adjustable sliders on a Cartesian coordinate system.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Mathematics
Trigonometry
Signal Processing
Sine Waves
learningObjectives: Identify amplitude, period, and phase as the three parameters that fully define the plotted sine wave
Predict how increasing the amplitude slider stretches the wave vertically without changing its period
Explain the inverse relationship between the period slider value and the number of cycles drawn across the canvas
Compare the horizontal shift produced by positive versus negative phase slider values
Calculate the frequency of the displayed wave from its period on the Cartesian grid
